test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following Committees in India is related to Tax reforms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Chelliah Committee**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raja Chelliah Committee** is known for its significant contributions to tax reforms in India.
 
• The committee was established to recommend measures for the reform of the tax system in the country, aiming to create a more efficient and equitable tax structure.
 
• It played a pivotal role in the rationalization of tax policies, including the introduction of Value Added Tax (VAT) and other reforms.
 
• The recommendations of the **Raja Chelliah Committee** have had a lasting impact on the fiscal policy and tax administration in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meera Seth Committee** was related to the development of handloom industry.
 
• **Ghosh Committee** was related to the functioning of the money market in India.
 
• **Anand Sinha Committee** was set up to review the governance of boards of banks in India.
 
• Tax reforms are crucial for ensuring a fair and effective tax system, which can boost economic growth and public welfare.
